offers.title: Copywriting Intern
offers.description:
Hooli is a bank for people who live between countries. We write everything ourselves: the app, the emails, the ads.

As our Copywriting Intern you write app copy, help with campaign headlines and test which words make people act. You work with a senior copywriter and the product team, and you ship something every week.

You are studying or just graduated in communication, journalism, marketing or a related field. You write sharp, short English and you like rewriting a sentence ten times until it is right.

The internship runs for six months, four or five days a week, at our office in Amsterdam. We pay a monthly internship allowance and you get the same lunch, laptop and training budget as everyone else.

offers.title: Branch Manager, Belgium & Ireland
offers.description:
Hooli is opening branches in Belgium and Ireland, and we need someone to run them from day one.

As Branch Manager you hire and lead a small team in each country, set up the local processes with our compliance team, and make sure every customer who walks in leaves with their problem solved. You report to the head of operations.

You have at least five years of experience running a branch, a store or a service team, including hiring. You speak English fluently; French or Dutch is a plus. You travel between Brussels and Dublin about twice a month.

We offer a permanent contract, a relocation package if you need one, and shares in the company.
